description: Header file defining the WebSocketBasicHandshakeStream class, which manages the WebSocket handshake process over a network stream, including request registration, stream initialization, request sending, response handling, and connection management.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicHandshakeStream
classes.description: Final class managing the WebSocket handshake process, including request registration, stream initialization, request sending, response validation, and connection reuse management.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request information for the handshake.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the network stream for the handshake process.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads the response headers from the server.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body from the server.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, optionally not reusable.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully read.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if the connection has been reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection can be reused.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketStream after successful handshake.

methods.name: CanReadFromStream
methods.description: Checks if stream can be read from.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the stream.

methods.name: SetWebSocketKeyForTesting
methods.description: Sets the WebSocket key for testing purposes.
